scope.zh: 前超光速文明因完全觉察而首次接触：入侵/轰炸、满觉察度或“监视者”三个入口汇入同一“首次接触”窗口。
scope.en: Pre-FTL first contact through awareness: invasion/bombardment, full awareness or "Who Watches the Watchers" all converge on one First Contact window.

uncertain: action.2 and progress.4/5/6 are also used by ordinary first contact (first_contact.6000), so these windows are shared across stories; here they are only this story's convergence point.

label.zh: 两个满觉察度入口（另有隐藏的入侵/轰炸入口 awareness.125）
label.en: Two full-awareness entries (plus the hidden invade/bombard entry awareness.125)

note.zh: 910：觉察度升到“完全”时（on_awareness_level_increase → 900）建立通信；920：由前超光速科技进步局势（preftl.41）在已达完全觉察后触发的“监视者”事件。125：对前超光速行星轰炸或入侵时把觉察度设为100并立即建立联系。
note.en: 910: when awareness rises to full (on_awareness_level_increase -> 900) comms are established; 920: fired by the pre-FTL tech-progress situation (preftl.41) once full awareness was reached. 125: bombarding or invading a pre-FTL planet sets awareness to 100 and contacts them at once.

label.zh: 按帝国首次接触的情形选择通知
label.en: Notification chosen by the empire's contact situation

note.zh: 由 action.2 的 after 块按条件选择（progress.9 另有分支，见起源 Payback）。
note.en: Selected by the after block of action.2 (progress.9 branches elsewhere, see the Payback origin).

texts.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在[contact_empire_system.GetName]星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是[contact_empire.GetName]也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
texts.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the [contact_empire_system.GetName] system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the [contact_empire.GetName] have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is now unavoidable.

texts.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
texts.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

texts.zh: 不可思议！星星上的来客？这还真是出乎意料。你们可让我们有些措手不及。
texts.en: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.

texts.zh: 来自另一颗星球的访客？我们一直认为外面一定还有其他的感性生命体存在，但即使是这样，此时此刻也是极具里程碑意义的！我们还不太清楚你们的习俗是什么样的。
texts.en: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.

texts.zh: 多年以来我们都等待机会进行接触。在这样一个广袤无垠、遍布奇迹的宇宙，我们坚信一定有如同我们一样的生命存在。
texts.en: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.

texts.zh: 终于！过了这么久你们终于决定揭示自己的存在了。你们已经观察我们的星球有好一段时间了，我没说错吧？
texts.en: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?

texts.zh: 啊，原来你在这！我们这么多年以来一直在等你方发起接触进程，实在等不及了，所以我们决定迈出第一步。那么现在该怎么办？
texts.en: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?

texts.zh:
欧，这就是你们的沟通方式吗？其实你们刚通过超空间航道进来的时候我们就已经一直在关注你们了，但一直没把它弄明白。坐着这种大铁盒子旅行危险不危险啊？

我感觉我们有很多可以互相学习的，如果你们也是这么认为的那么欢迎光临啊。但如果你对我们的家园图谋不轨，我们可不会任人宰割。
texts.en:
Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?

It seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.

texts.zh: 入侵者们！我们不明白你们为什么要攻击我们，但我们会誓死保卫我们的殖民地！至死方休！
texts.en: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our colony! We will not yield!

label.zh: 丑陋的东西……你的长相恶心到我们了。
label.en: Hideous creatures... Your visage sickens us.

label.zh: 愿神圣降于你们与你们的星球之上。
label.en: Divine greetings upon you and your world.

label.zh: 我们即将给你们混乱不堪的生活方式带去秩序。稍等。
label.en: We will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.

label.zh: 我们的相通点远超你们想象。
label.en: We are more alike than you realize.

label.zh: 你们真觉得自己是什么高等文明？妙啊。
label.en: You believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.
We are one. You are many.

label.zh: 我们为一。你们也为一。现在，世界为二。
label.en: We are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.

label.zh: 我们希望能够同你们建立互利互惠的关系。
label.en: We hope to build a profitable relationship with you.

notes.zh: 窗口文字取决于被接触文明的觉察度等级（无/低/中/高/完全）与其是否被入侵。
notes.en: The window text depends on the contacted civilization's awareness level (none/low/medium/high/full) and whether it is being invaded.

texts.zh:
我们围绕[fromfrom.GetName]建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。

我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
texts.en:
We built an observation post around [fromfrom.GetName] to study its inhabitants, only to realize the [contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of our [root.GetScientistPlural].

Our previous activity in this solar system must have alerted the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] to our presence. Efforts to keep our existence hidden are futile at this point.

summary.text:
# 第一次接触 / First Contact

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/pre_ftl_awareness_events.txt:235-268,648-753`；`events/on_action_events_1.txt:3439-3680`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5082`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 三个入口：1）对前超光速文明的行星轰炸或入侵：awareness.125 把觉察度设为100，建立联系并发出 action.2（机器人起义不算）；2）觉察度升至“完全”：on_awareness_level_increase → 隐藏 awareness.900 → 910「暴露！」；3）前超光速科技进步局势（preftl.41）在其已达完全觉察后发出 920「谁在监视监视者？」（也由观测站建造的 fircon.30 附带通信）。
  Three entries: 1) bombarding or invading a pre-FTL civilization: awareness.125 sets awareness to 100, makes contact and fires action.2 (the robot uprising does not count); 2) awareness reaches "full": on_awareness_level_increase -> hidden awareness.900 -> 910 "Exposed!"; 3) the pre-FTL tech-progress situation (preftl.41) fires 920 "Who Watches the Watchers?" once full awareness was reached (fircon.30 also adds communications when an observation station is built).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 910 / 920 的选项都把玩家带到 action.2「首次接触」：窗口文字按被接触文明的觉察度而不同；窗口后按条件显示 progress.4/5/6 的通知（第一次外星遭遇 / 发展中文明）。
  The options of 910 and 920 both lead to action.2 "First Contact", whose text depends on the contacted civilization's awareness level; afterwards progress.4/5/6 notifications appear by condition (first alien encounter / developing civilization).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三个入口并行（不同情形各自触发）；progress.4/5/6 按条件互斥。
  The three entries are parallel (different situations); progress.4/5/6 are exclusive by condition.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项按伦理（亲外/排外/灵性/唯物/军国/和平/平等）显示不同措辞；风暴追逐者起源有专属版本。
  Option wording varies with ethics (xenophile/xenophobe/spiritualist/materialist/militarist/pacifist/egalitarian); Storm Chasers have their own variant.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：awareness.125/900/910/920 的触发与 action.2 的描述变体和 after 分支。
  Checked: triggers of awareness.125/900/910/920 and the description variants and after branches of action.2.
- 更正：原三个故事（125 / 900 / fircon-30）各自挂同一个 action.2；合并后 fircon.5026 归入哈宾特故事。
  Correction: the three draft stories (125 / 900 / fircon-30) each hung the same action.2; merged now, and fircon.5026 moved to the Habinte story.
